introduction.title: Build a compact dictionary with prefix lookups
paragraphs: A trie organizes strings by their shared prefixes. Marisa builds one from a DuckDB column and stores the dictionary as a BLOB. Queries can check membership, find strings beginning with a prefix, or find a prefix that matches a longer input.

Use it for a reusable vocabulary, a lookup dictionary, or autocomplete suggestions over a known list. The built dictionary is static: create a new trie when its contents change. For approximate spelling matches, use [RapidFuzz](/products/extensions/rapidfuzz/).
